channels.title: WhatsApp Concierge

channels.title: Email Support
channels.subtitle: Written support follow-up
channels.detail: Use email for order corrections, refund follow-up, and account issues that need written confirmation.

channels.title: Order Desk
channels.subtitle: Tracked delivery assistance
channels.detail: After checkout, the order timeline remains available in-app so support can resolve delivery questions with context.

faqs.question: When do delivery fees appear?
faqs.answer: Delivery pricing appears as soon as you choose an address and delivery method in checkout, before you place the order.

faqs.question: Where is cash on delivery available?
faqs.answer: Cash on delivery is validated by governorate during checkout. Eligible areas show the COD fee before review and payment confirmation.

faqs.question: Where can I track my orders?
faqs.answer: Open Account, then Order History to view status, totals, delivery address, and the full order timeline.

faqs.question: How are returns handled?
faqs.answer: Return support is initiated from the order detail experience or through client support, depending on the product and delivery status.
